items.scenario: You paid roughly half of what is owed last week and plan to pay the rest later. The supplier is asking for the full amount. The bill is more than three months overdue.
items.reply: aadha payment last week kar diya tha, baki thoda time lagega

items.scenario: The GST number printed on the bill is wrong, so your accounts team cannot process it. The supplier is asking why payment is delayed. They have been following up regularly for over a month now.
items.reply: invoice pe GST no galat hai isliye accounts process nahi kar raha. corrected invoice bhej do

items.scenario: The goods receipt note has not been entered by your stores team yet, so the bill cannot move forward. The supplier is following up. The bill is more than three months overdue.
items.reply: GRN abhi stores se enter nahi hua hai, isi wajah se payment process nahi ho pa raha

items.scenario: Your accounts team cannot find the purchase order number for this bill, so it is stuck. The supplier is asking about payment. The supplier has messaged you once before about this.
items.reply: PO number nahi mil raha accounts ko. aap share kar sakte ho kya

items.scenario: You have no particular reason for not paying and no clear plan for when you will. The supplier has messaged asking for an update. The supplier has messaged you once before about this.
items.reply: haan dekhta hu, abhi exact kuch confirm nahi kar paunga

items.scenario: You paid this bill a few days ago by bank transfer. The supplier seems not to have noticed and is asking again. The supplier has messaged you once before about this.
items.reply: ye payment toh 2-3 din pehle transfer kar diya tha, ek baar check kar lo

items.scenario: This is a small supplier and you have bigger payments to worry about this month. You are not planning to pay them yet. They have messaged you again.
items.reply: abhi thode bade payments pending hain, iska thoda baad me karenge

items.scenario: Your company pays all suppliers in one batch on the 10th of each month. This bill missed the last batch. The supplier has messaged asking where the payment is. The supplier has messaged you once before about this.
items.reply: 10th ko supplier payments ka batch hota hai, ye last batch me miss ho gaya tha. next me chala jayega
